calibration.purpose: pairing-mechanics calibration only; not included in the formal denominator

formal.repeat_note: three repeats per scenario are consistency checks, not three independent scenarios

local_validation.purpose: developer validation without GitHub attestation; excluded from formal and calibration denominators

claims: Each pair is one workflow run: both arms share one build, one image and one attestation, so the only arm difference is the audit. The formal 18 pairs and calibration 3 pairs produce 21 workflow runs and 42 attempts.
The same deterministic pyz digest is measured at dev, qa and staging inside running containers for passing chains.
Every promotion edge is a real sequential compose deployment followed by a real digest and live HTTP health gate; the three stages are not started together and probed out of order.
PG-ART and PG-QA are baseline controls: the baseline gate rejects and the downstream stage is not deployed; neither arm runs the audit.
For the four audit scenarios, the P0/P1 comparison is conditional on both baselines passing and on semantic input equality.
All outputs are generated from retained raw and normalized evidence; injected defects are disclosed in injection.json.

injection_record.rule: A platform error is not accepted as the declared injection, and an injection is not inferred from one.

minimal_fields: native run identity (run key, arm, build, workflow, commit)
release binding (episode, service, environment chain, approved artifact digest)
candidates and dispositions (inventory digest, missing items, empty-set distinction)
history and successor (cutoff, audit time, findings, successor identity, frozen snapshot digest)
provenance tags: native / derived / declared / scripted / unavailable
release-stage records (container ID, image ID, image tag, expected and deployed pyz digest, HTTP status, gate status)
collector.missing_vs_empty: A missing value is recorded as unavailable or as an explicit missing item; it is never replaced by an empty set or a default PASS.
collector.nfi_rule: NFI is a subclass of machine OPEN. It is shown separately but never added to the OPEN total a second time.

rule.inventory: bounded stage-health inventory emitted by the staged runner
rule.window: dev -> qa -> staging, one signal per deployed stage

denominators.audit_contrast_pairs: only selected comparable pairs whose two baseline outcomes are PASS and whose scenario requires an audit case
denominators.baseline_control_pairs: PG-ART and PG-QA selected comparable pairs, reported separately and never mixed into the audit-contrast numerator

identity_types.attestation_subject: the .pyz file; the deployed object is an OCI image, so both identities and the verified binding are recorded
identity_types.deployed_artifact: sha256 measured inside the running stage container
identity_types.oci_image: Docker image config digest recorded separately; never compared numerically with the pyz digest
identity_types.pinned_artifact: sha256 of dist/release_app.pyz bytes written by tools/build.py

per_stage_gate: digest equals the pinned artifact digest
live HTTP GET /health returns 200 and body.stage == stage
design.promotion: build once -> deploy dev -> gate dev -> deploy qa -> gate qa -> deploy staging -> gate staging -> collect -> P0 not configured / P1 audit

time_model.pairing_projection: native stage timestamps become fixed per-stage ordinals; absolute wall-clock seconds and host ports are removed; verifier order relations are preserved; the native case.json remains the audit input
scripted: PG-SEQ Finding observed_at / Requirement accepted_at / target times as fixed offsets from the live cutoff

formal_eligibility: GitHub attestation mode with verify exit 0
both arms of the selected pair valid and comparable
non_claims: This is not a production deployment or a full production inventory.
Candidates, Findings, dispositions, audit times and fault switches are synthetic test inputs generated from the frozen scenario files; no engineering dataset is read, copied or bridged.
The collector scope attestation is self-declared for the bounded three-stage chain, not an independent third-party export.
The OCI image digest is an identity of a different type from the pyz digest; no numerical equality between them is claimed.
This batch does not re-measure the existing E2 batch in this repository and does not claim those results are reproduced.
The calibration batch calibrates pairing mechanics; it is not a second independent sample.

pairing_rules.arm_order: alternates P0>P1 and P1>P0 by repeat; the order is recorded but is not a scenario variable
pairing_rules.batch_immutability: the formal and calibration batch ids in this protocol are frozen; a configuration change requires a new protocol and a new batch
excluded_from_formal: any attempt whose pair is not comparable
runs from a dirty source tree
pairing_rules.retry_selection: first comparable attempt per (batch, scenario, repeat); every non-selected attempt stays in runs.csv with an exclusion reason
pairing_rules.same_audit_input: semantic projection equality for audit cases; baseline outcome signature equality for baseline-block pairs

required_evidence: ordered deploy/check/gate events for dev, qa, staging
same measured pyz digest at every stage
P1 verifier output CLOSED
P0 audit status NOT_CONFIGURED
scenarios.title: Normal release: staged promotion with no injected evidence defect

required_evidence: expected pyz digest and measured QA pyz digest
digest gate command exit / decision and QA container identity
staging container absence after rejection
P1 audit status NOT_RUN_UPSTREAM_BLOCKED (not OPEN)
scenarios.title: Artifact substitution at the QA gate

required_evidence: QA deployed pyz digest equals the pinned digest
live QA HTTP response status 503 and body
staging container absence after rejection
P1 audit status NOT_RUN_UPSTREAM_BLOCKED (not OPEN)
scenarios.title: QA health failure after correct artifact deployment

required_evidence: raw QA signal present in the bounded inventory
effective disposition count for the QA signal is zero
all baseline stage gates PASS
P1 OPEN with A1_EFFECTIVE_DISPOSITION_COUNT; P0 NOT_CONFIGURED
scenarios.title: Missing effective disposition while the raw signal and baseline gates remain

required_evidence: source cutoff and scripted Finding observation / Requirement acceptance offsets
Finding is not present in the frozen historical snapshot
frozen snapshot digest before and after the audit input build is unchanged
P1 OPEN with A2_REQUIREMENT_TEMPORAL_ORDER; P0 NOT_CONFIGURED

required_evidence: the missing query-scope field recorded as unavailable; completeness flag and collector version retained
extracted signals and inventory digest retained
P1 OPEN with evidence_status NFI and A1_SCOPE_NOT_ATTESTED
no invented empty-set or default-pass value

scope.note: Six scenario families (N01, B01, B02, C01, C02, I01) exercise staged promotion. The existing E2 batch in this repository is not changed or re-measured.

description.P0: staged promotion + minimal collector; audit NOT_CONFIGURED
description.P1: same staged promotion + same collector; closure audit runs after the staging gate PASS

not_implemented.B0: Optional third arm defined by the experiment design; out of scope for this batch.
